description: Television cameras, digital cameras and video camera recorders; radiation-hardened or radiation-tolerant goods as specified in subheading note 2 to this chapter

predecessors.note: Before 2022 all television and digital cameras were reported inside HS 852580. The continuous long series is at HS-4 8525.

lineage.familyNote: These codes together cover this product across the HS 2022 revision. They do not overlap in time, so stacking them gives a continuous series without apportioning anything.
